class.name: NNBTNodes
class.brief_description: Base class for all behaviour tree nodes.
class.description: Shared base node for Noodle Nodes behaviour trees. Build a behaviour tree by adding an [NNBTRoot] and assembling composite, decorator, and leaf nodes beneath it. Behaviour tree nodes return a [enum Status] on each tick ([constant SUCCESS], [constant FAILURE], [constant RUNNING], or [constant SKIP]) and share state through the owning root's [NNBlackboard]. Direct children of an [NNBTScoreBasedPicker] can also hold [NNConsideration] nodes for utility-based branch selection.

method.name: get_is_running
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while this node has an active run that has not yet completed or been interrupted.

method.name: get_tree_root
method.description: Returns a relative [NodePath] to the highest contiguous [NNBTNodes] ancestor.

method.name: interrupt
method.description: Cancels this node's active run (and any active child runs), invoking [method NNBTTaskNodes.on_interrupt] on active task nodes. Safe to call when not running.

method.name: reset
method.description: Interrupts this node and its subtree and clears persistent node state (such as [NNBTSequenceStar] memory, [NNBTLimiter] budget, or [NNBTRunOnce] latched results).

members.member: How child [NNConsiderations] scores are combined into [member score] when this node is a direct child of an [NNBTScoreBasedPicker]. Defaults to [constant NoodleNodes.EVALUATION_MULTIPLY].
Most recently computed utility score for this node when evaluated by an [NNBTScoreBasedPicker].
Status returned by this node's most recent tick.

constants.constant: The node is still in progress and will be ticked again.
The node was skipped. [NNBTSequence] and [NNBTSelector] move on to the next child, and [NNBTParallel] treats it as success.
